preconditions.description: Attacker must have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to grant themselves MINTER_ROLE, BOSS_CONTROL_ROLE, or SWEEPER_ROLE

exploit_hint: Attacker with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can: 1) Call grantRole(MINTER_ROLE, attacker) to mint unlimited tokens via mint(), 2) Call setAddressForBosses(attacker) then withDraw() to transfer all contract token balance to attacker, 3) Call sweepTokenForBosses() to swap contract tokens for ETH via Uniswap. The admin has unrestricted access to mint, burn, withdraw funds, and transfer admin privileges.
